lines.speaker: granger
lines.text: Help on the Tellico! Penny a sheet, patrons of letters. The stranger's reasons cost extra, and I don't have them.

lines.speaker: granger
lines.text: News from the Tellico, and three tellings for every tale. Penny a sheet. If you want a witness, don't mistake the printer for one.

lines.speaker: granger
lines.text: News from the Tellico, and three tellings for every tale. Penny a sheet. If you want a witness, don't mistake the printer for one.

lines.speaker: granger
lines.text: A share on the road, a bargain on the page. Penny a sheet. I print the price I'm told; I wasn't there to call it fair.

lines.speaker: granger
lines.text: Trouble on the Tellico! Penny a sheet. Everybody's got the blame worked out; nobody agrees on the rest. Buy two and argue with yourself.

lines.speaker: talbot
lines.text: Billie Tupper jumped a train over a hole. Over a HOLE. She told me herself. Well. She told the whole street, and I was standing in it.

lines.speaker: pike
lines.text: That silver case carries a mark from case-working tools I made years ago. Not the bullet mould. Come by after dark and I'll show you the drawings; they don't tell us the customer's name.

lines.speaker: nell
lines.text: Delegate Belden's wagon reached Greenwater. People ate. Now he's asking about a continuing agreement, and they can argue over it with something in their stomachs. The missing grain still belongs on somebody's account.

lines.speaker: vane
lines.text: Your Line 14 book is quite safe with me. I have read it twice. Somebody at that yard has a steady hand and a dead man's stamp. I do admire thrift.

lines.speaker: vane
lines.text: I hear the Night Mail had a difficult evening, and that somebody was paid for it in the Cut. Do not look alarmed. I am the last man in this valley to think the less of you.

lines.speaker: keene
lines.text: The physic came in on the Night Mail at dawn. Eleven children on my list. I had been choosing which four. I don't have to choose. Whoever you are, go and eat something.

lines.speaker: keene
lines.text: No Night Mail. No physic. I have eleven children on a list and enough for four. I am told somebody on that train was paid. I should like very much to be shown which somebody.
